pairs.subject: invariant-placement
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/library/_port/present.ts:53 The one emission door (present.ts cardOf/faceOf/detailOf) leaves out absent optional parts everywhere else. Here, though, a take with no peaks gets an invented empty waveform, so the tile can't tell a missing measurement from a measured silence; completeness-at-emission says an absent optional part is omitted, never defaulted.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/library/_port/present.ts:53 Face 'wave' requires peaks (Face.tsx:32). The emitter fills the missing part with [] when the decision rule says the part should be required or the consumer should apply the fallback. Elsewhere detailOf omits optional parts with conditional spreads (schedule, atelier, model).

app/(studio)/library/_port/fixture.ts:117 The query rule sits at the door altitude: the fixture goes through the kernel index's own querySchema, so both sides refuse the same input. The actions also have a zod door at the action core.
app/(studio)/library/_port/present.ts:129 pinned is computed from the acts the index offers, not declared next to them. 'locked' is likewise derived from kind+state in cardOf.

app/(studio)/library/_port/fixture.ts:128 A Record over the owned kind union makes a new LibraryKind stop the build here. faceOf (present.ts:59) does end in a designed-face default arm, but Face.tsx states that as the rule for every kind with no cover.

app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:127 Opening the store can fail, so no token is minted. Each verb asks again and gets a typed reason when the store is absent. Exception: handoff.ts:297 discards the kernel's reason and passes the id through.

app/(studio)/library/_port/real.ts:183 The kernel answers a repeated pin with 'nothing changed'. The port refuses it instead of quietly agreeing, so a stale toggle leaves a signal. Small label coercions (title falling back to id) are display labels, not guards.

app/(studio)/library/_port/present.ts:42 'Cannot serve this blob' is carried by the wrapper (null), not by a pseudo-kind added to the set. No none-of-these member was found in the kinds or faces this port produces.

tests/next-server/library-fixture-parity.test.ts:156 The raised door has negative artifacts: refused queries (unknown group, offset past bound, empty facet value, fractional limit) are asserted as refusals by code and words on both sides.
app/(studio)/library/_port/fixture.ts:245 This is idempotent mark-writing (delivery semantics), not a single-use value or one-shot authorisation, so the technique's precondition does not hold.
